scope: New marketplace API/domain implementation, cross-review findings from root/visual plus independent review of account/checkout UI. No source or data copied from Agentura, Pipeline Studio or Veera.

findings.finding: An in-flight account-A mutation could operate on account B after a session change because the mock looked up the active identity only at execution time.
findings.fix: Snapshot session generation in Axios header and reject stale supplied generation before private/cart operations. Session changes increment generation. Stale logout is also rejected.
findings.evidence: src/domain/session-transport.test.ts: stale mutation/current generation/stale logout tests pass

findings.finding: A stale 401 response could clear the newer valid client session even after server-side identity guarding.
findings.fix: Transport compares captured generation to the current generation and does not clear newer session cache for an outdated request.
findings.evidence: session-transport test a stale response cannot clear newer valid client account passes

findings.finding: Hashing raw JSON made semantically identical idempotency payloads conflict when key order changed.
findings.fix: Normalize and validate explicit order fields in fixed order before hashing; strip unknown fields.
findings.evidence: marketplace test semantic reordered payload recovers same order passes

findings.finding: Zero quantities from corrupted storage or a sold-out guest merge could produce a fee-only quote.
findings.fix: Reject nonpositive/invalid persisted quantities, remove zero merged entries at login.
findings.evidence: marketplace test rejects zero quantity passes

findings.finding: Reset left scheduled order identities in memory, blocking a later scenario with the same deterministic order ID.
findings.fix: Track timer handles and cancel/clear all scheduled orders during full reset.

findings.finding: Socket.IO initially bypassed or missed MSW due early constructor capture and MSW2.15 Socket.IO path normalization.
findings.fix: Dynamic client import after worker installation and explicit custom Engine.IO path /marketplace-events/ matched by MSW. Binding handles protocol encoding and handshake.
findings.evidence: Browser test proved connected status and visible cart price update via socket; global live announcement added by parent

findings.finding: A definitively rejected order left its persisted attempt disabling checkout forever.
findings.fix: Flow author clears only definitively rejected attempts after lookup confirms no committed order; uncertain network/timeouts keep the key.

findings.finding: Wallet/network mismatch could create an invalid persisted attempt.
findings.fix: Validate network against saved wallet before review; API also rejects mismatches.

findings.finding: Profile mutation could overwrite a newer session cache with a response from a previous user.
findings.fix: UI onSuccess checks active session ID before setting profile; transport also guards generations.

findings.finding: Nested main landmarks and mismatched avatar limit impaired accessibility/validation.
findings.fix: Single main in Layout and feature sections, avatar350KB validation aligned.
findings.evidence: Account/checkout components refactored by flow author

findings.finding: An older successful GET session null response could arrive after login, downgrade transport generation and clear the new session.
findings.fix: Reject older-generation successful auth/session responses before any state write; propagate AbortSignal to every session query; await query cancellation before accepting a new user.
findings.evidence: src/domain/session-transport.test.ts: an old successful null session cannot overwrite a newer login;28/28 domain+HTTP tests pass; TypeScript passes.

findings.finding: Transport relied on TypeScript generics for complete critical response shapes.
findings.fix: Full Zod4 runtime schemas now validate NFT, catalog, user, wallet, cart, quote, order, favorites and session responses in actual service methods.
findings.evidence: 10 malformed/valid payload tests added;38/38domainHTTPtests pass,tsc and targetedESLint pass.

tests.unitAndHttp: 38/38 domain+HTTP tests pass after runtime response schemas.
tests.typescript: tsc --noEmit passed after services split and deterministic replay/sold-out endpoints.
tests.independentUi: 2/2 desktop browser tests passed in stable run: changed quote requires second explicit confirmation with zero orders before it; logout/account switch isolates favorites and profile.
tests.runtime: All data fictional and persisted locally for demonstration; no real payments, credentials or private API dependencies

limitations: This is a browser demo, not a production authentication boundary. Direct fixture fetches without generation headers remain supported for test setup.
No formal claim of full Figma fidelity: upstream Figma access unavailable.
Unit and HTTP tests do not substitute the parent final full Playwright/visual/Lighthouse gate.
architecture: Actual Axios creation/interceptors are in src/services/http/index.ts; endpoint facade is in src/services/marketplace/index.ts; src/lib/api.ts only compatibility reexports.

fixedDemoScenarios.nftReplay: POST /api/demo/nft-replay emits duplicate current event twice then one older version without mutating database. Socket.IO binding transport only.
fixedDemoScenarios.soldOut: POST /api/demo/nft-update supports soldOut:true and increments NFT version.
